ben: I can fix links. which anchors are 404?

hao: Also the JS snippet still uses `max_inflight`; SDK v1.10 is `max_concurrency`. quick replace.

sara: thanks. can we add one short sentence under quant tips: 'q4 variants on very short prompts can show transient p50 increases; mitigate with a small warmup or larger batch_size'? keeps it non-prescriptive.

hao: added the sentence and pushed. CI shows lint ok.
